boxes.text: ## Delay a signal by a set number of milliseconds ##
So you don't accidentally go scheduling something three years in the future.

Pulse length as a percentage for gates coming out second outlet.  Though it says 0% and 100%, it will always output a distinct gate signal from one gate to the next.  (i.e. there will always be a release)

With triggered turned on, the events produced will be snapped to the clock signal (or its subdivisions) coming in the second inlet.  The module will attempt to follow changing pulses so that future events will line up with the current tempo.
Counts down the time until the next attack
CV Time (say you wanted a delay with changing times according to the Poisson distribution...)
